events.body:
## Context

`public/dashboard.html` shows "Export started", "Import started" and "Subscriber suppressed" toasts, but `src/entry.py` has no such endpoints and `public/docs.html` advertises import/export. Admins are told actions succeeded when nothing happened. Implementing them touches subscriber privacy (#25), so this issue only disables them.

## What to do

1. Disable the three buttons with a "Not available yet" title.
2. Remove the import/export claims from `docs.html`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No success toast for an action that didn't happen

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-newsletter && wrangler dev --local --port 8794   # open /dashboard
```

---
Size: **S**. Comment `/assign` to claim this issue; claims with no activity are released after 7 days. Clone from https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git and open your pull request there.
